methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $50M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Orbital Marine Power is a Growth-stage ocean and maritime technology company that has raised $50M+ to date. The comparable universe for this sector is sparse, consisting of one identified private peer (Ocean Infinity) and no public comparables, reflecting the nascent nature of frontier ocean technologies.

The valuation analysis applies a Stage-Progression method, which is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. This method uses the $50M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, implying a value of $60M. The limited comp availability and absence of public market anchors constrain the robustness of this approach.

The triangulated valuation range is $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median of $60M. The narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the sparse private peer set, absence of public comparables for calibration, and the early-stage dynamics of the ocean technology sector, which limit confidence in stage-progression multiples. Any valuation in this range should be understood as provisional pending access to additional comparable transaction data or revenue multiples from peers with established financial performance.
